title: Blueberry Hill Estates
blurb: Blueberry Hill Estates offers fresh blueberries with a pick-your-own patch, artisan preserves, and a cheese shop. The winery produces small-batch wines, some only available at the winery. Front Road Ciderworks creates small-batch ciders with Ontario fruit. They also host events such as weddings and corporate meetings.
